sources.entry: PsiTransfer - Simple file sharing solution with robust up-/download-resume and password protection. BSD-2-Clause Nodejs
PsiTransfer | Simple file sharing with resumable uploads and expiry

summary.one_liner: PsiTransfer is a self-hosted, open source file sharing web app with resumable uploads and downloads, optional password protection, and expiring upload buckets.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes PsiTransfer as a simple self-hosted alternative to paid file-sharing services like Dropbox and WeTransfer. It needs no accounts or logins and offers a responsive interface with a Vue-based frontend. Uploads and downloads are resumable via tus.io, and it supports very large files through streams. Users can set an expiry time on an upload bucket, enable one-time downloads, and download all files as a zip or tar.gz archive. An /admin page lists bucket information once an admin password is set. Buckets can be given explicit named IDs through a query parameter.
notable: No accounts or logins; simple self-hosted deployment via Docker or Node
Resumable up- and downloads using the tus.io protocol
One-time downloads and bucket expiry times
Download all files as zip or tar.gz
caveats: No end-to-end payload encryption, per the README's side notes
Admin page is disabled until adminPass is configured
